{{Top|canon=Glasses}}
[[File:Noa_briqualon.jpg|thumb|[[Noa Briqualon]] wearing spectacles]]

{{Quote|-he'll just kill us both, take the ship, and be done with it. ''That's'' what my 'vision' tells me.''"<br />"''Well, maybe you need glasses, then.|[[Celia Durasha|Celia "Crimson" Durasha]] and [[Kaj Nedmak]]|<ref name="Crimson Bounty">{{JournalCite|14|Crimson Bounty}}</ref>}}
'''Spectacles''', also called ''' eyeglasses''' or simply '''glasses''', were a primitive way of augmenting one's sight, consisting of two small discs made of visually corrective lenses which were placed in front of one's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].

==History==
[[File:Specs.jpg|thumb|left|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] wearing spectacles as a disguise]]
Spectacles were rare, as advanced surgery and cybernetic implants were more efficient in many ways. Yet a few individuals used spectacles. [[Noa Briqualon]], who was stranded on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], used spectacles,<ref name="EBE">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref> as did [[Saun Dann]]<ref name="HS">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref> and unidentified patrons in bars on both [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]<ref name="Dr">{{DroidsCite|Across the Roon Sea}}</ref> and [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]].<ref name="m7">[[Star Wars (1977) 7|''Star Wars'' (1977) 7]]</ref> [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] stole the spectacles from the Roon bar patron and wore them as an attempt to disguise himself from [[Bisad Koong]]'s henchmen.<ref name="Dr" /> [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]], a scientist working for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], also possessed spectacles, although he used them only occasionally.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>

[[Vago Gejalli Thokka|Vago the Hutt]] used spectacles on occasion.<ref name="TF">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref> [[Wald (pilot)|Wald]], the [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], also wore spectacles.<ref name="M60">[[Star Wars (1977) 60|''Star Wars'' (1977) 60]]</ref> [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]],<ref name="M25">[[Star Wars (1977) 25|''Star Wars'' (1977) 25]]</ref> [[Korkeal Hai]],<ref name="gg6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> [[Retter Lewis]]<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref> and [[Garindan/Legends|Garindan]]<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> used goggles. [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]] [[Eugene Talmont]] was nearsighted, but refused to wear spectacles due to vanity. The [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] shaman [[Umwak]] created his special glasses to find a way through [[Arbo Maze]]; however, he didn't see a thing in them.<ref name="Etol">{{Ewoks|The Tree of Light}}</ref>

[[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] forger [[Magar Jaros]] corrected his defective vision with ''computerized magnifocals'', which were similar to a pince-nez.<ref name="G11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref> The human forger [[Battz]] wore a pair of spectacles in which one eye had a special magnification lens.<ref name="InstAdv">''[[Instant Adventures]]''</ref>

[[Darnada]], a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]], wore a [[Monocle/Legends|monocle]]. This was a corrective lens that was worn over only one eye, and was often more of a status symbol than a practical accessory.<ref name="DM">[[Darth Maul (2000) 2|''Darth Maul'' (2000) 2]]</ref> [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] wore a similar type of spectacles while he served on the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]].<ref name="HfZ">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref>

Captain [[Telettoh]] also wore spectacles, as early as [[3963 BBY]].<ref name="KOTOR42">[[Knights of the Old Republic 42|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 42]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Although [[George Lucas]] did not want eyeglasses to be present in his films,<ref name="Hyp">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/postnotes/news20041124.html|series=Episode III Post Notes|text=Part of the Coruscant Elite}}</ref> such devices have nonetheless appeared in other [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] sources such as "[[Blue Shadow Virus (episode)|Blue Shadow Virus]]" of [[The Clone Wars: Season One|''The Clone Wars'': Season One]].<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" />
